name: ThinkTwice - Save Money
description:
ThinkTwice helps you stop impulse buys by showing the “real cost” of spending. 

Not just the price tag — but how much time it costs, and how much money it could become if you invested it instead. 

So before you buy that random thing you don’t even need… you can quickly check: 

How many work hours it costs 

What it could grow into over time Your progress toward saving goals 

Small wins that actually add up fast It’s not about strict budgets or boring spreadsheets. 

It’s about making smarter choices without feeling broke or guilty. 

The best part? You’re not doing it alone. 

See other people hitting goals, skipping purchases, and stacking savings — so it feels motivating instead of depressing. 

Save money. Stop impulse buying. Your future you will thank you.
